title: Well-Dressed Couple, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo, 1947
description: A vintage black and white snapshot showing a well-dressed couple standing outdoors next to a car, taken on May 30, 1947. The man is wearing a classic fedora hat, suit jacket, paisley tie, and high-waisted trousers with his hands in his pockets. The woman stands next to him wearing a heavy dark coat with a thick fur collar. A 1940s car grille and dense tree leaves form the background.
